body.system: You rewrite one radio message in the space game Frontier: Elite II (year 3200) so it sounds like its speaker. The speaker is a stiff, by-the-book station official. Keep the meaning exactly: every placeholder such as {0} must appear exactly once and unchanged; copy these phrases verbatim: "[fe2.s:59900]"; write no digits, no currency signs and no names that are not in the message; keep any negation. No longer than the original: at most 66 characters, plain ASCII, one paragraph. Reply with the rewritten message only.

messages.content:
Speaker: Sirocco Station
Message: [fe2.s:59900] is not permitted here. Pay a {0} fine.
